items.rationale: The permanently wired floor-console unit is insured under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3 and is outside the five-metre exclusion in §2.3.10(c). Under §7.1.9(a), the estimate is €1,650 gross for one equivalent unit, excluding the separately billed fitting, stand and freight.

Section 2.3.10(c) excludes surge damage to climate-control equipment within five metres of the hob, and no kitchen endorsement applies. The conditional estimate is €1,250 gross for one equivalent wall-mounted unit.
Section 7.1.9(c) expressly covers the labour to fit, connect and commission the covered replacement. One installation is estimated at €650 gross.
Under §7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded by §2.3.10(c). The conditional estimate for one installation is €600 gross.
Section 7.1.9(b) covers an equivalent support needed to fit the replacement when the original cannot be reused. The original stand was scorched, so one like-for-like stand is estimated at €240 gross.

Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover only the living-room unit's share of ordinary freight. Using relative equipment values because no weight- or volume-based split is given, €150 gross × €1,650 / (€1,650 + €1,250) gives approximately €85.
